examples.hanzi: 我的手机卡还没有激活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de shǒujī kǎ hái méiyǒu jīhuó.
examples.english: My phone SIM card hasn't been activated yet.

examples.hanzi: 运动可以激活大脑，让人更有精神。
examples.pinyin: Yùndòng kěyǐ jīhuó dànǎo, ràng rén gèng yǒu jīngshen.
examples.english: Exercise can activate the brain and make people more energetic.

examples.hanzi: 这件胸罩的尺寸有点小。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn xiōngzhào de chǐcùn yǒudiǎn xiǎo.
examples.english: This bra is a little small in size.

examples.hanzi: 她在网上给自己买了两件运动胸罩。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài wǎngshàng gěi zìjǐ mǎi le liǎng jiàn yùndòng xiōngzhào.
examples.english: She bought two sports bras for herself online.

examples.hanzi: 这个手机的最大优点是电池耐用。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shǒujī de zuì dà yōudiǎn shì diànchí nàiyòng.
examples.english: The biggest advantage of this phone is its durable battery.

examples.hanzi: 他的优点是做事认真。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yōudiǎn shì zuòshì rènzhēn.
examples.english: His strength is that he works carefully.

examples.hanzi: 他是一番好意，你别误会。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yì fān hǎoyì, nǐ bié wùhuì.
examples.english: He meant well, so don't get the wrong idea.

examples.hanzi: 我是出于好意才提醒你的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì chūyú hǎoyì cái tíxǐng nǐ de.
examples.english: I only reminded you out of good intentions.

examples.hanzi: 这个房间的空调坏了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fángjiān de kōngtiáo huài le.
examples.english: The air conditioner in this room is broken.

examples.hanzi: 请把空调开到二十六度。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ kōngtiáo kāi dào èrshíliù dù.
examples.english: Please set the air conditioner to twenty-six degrees.

examples.hanzi: 请在要记住的地方做个记号。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng zài yào jìzhù de dìfang zuò gè jìhào.
examples.english: Please make a mark where you need to remember.

examples.hanzi: 我在地图上画了一个红色的记号。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài dìtú shàng huà le yí gè hóngsè de jìhào.
examples.english: I drew a red mark on the map.

examples.hanzi: 老人被骗子诈骗了一万块钱。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén bèi piànzi zhàpiàn le yíwàn kuài qián.
examples.english: The old man was swindled out of ten thousand yuan by a con artist.

examples.hanzi: 手机上经常收到诈骗短信。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī shàng jīngcháng shōudào zhàpiàn duǎnxìn.
examples.english: I often receive scam text messages on my phone.

examples.hanzi: 这样做有什么是非，以后自然会知道。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò yǒu shénme shìfēi, yǐhòu zìrán huì zhīdào.
examples.english: What the rights and wrongs of doing this are will become clear later.

examples.hanzi: 他不喜欢在背后议论别人的是非。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xǐhuan zài bèihòu yìlùn biérén de shìfēi.
examples.english: He doesn't like gossiping behind people's backs.

examples.hanzi: 商家用打折作诱饵，吸引了很多顾客。
examples.pinyin: Shāngjiā yòng dǎzhé zuò yòu'ěr, xīyǐn le hěn duō gùkè.
examples.english: The store used discounts as bait to attract lots of customers.

examples.hanzi: 不要被免费的诱饵骗了。
examples.pinyin: Búyào bèi miǎnfèi de yòu'ěr piàn le.
examples.english: Don't be fooled by free bait.

examples.hanzi: 这个飞龙形状的风筝很大。
examples.pinyin: Zhège fēilóng xíngzhuàng de fēngzheng hěn dà.
examples.english: This dragon-shaped kite is very big.

examples.hanzi: 故事里有一条会喷火的飞龙。
examples.pinyin: Gùshi lǐ yǒu yì tiáo huì pēn huǒ de fēilóng.
examples.english: There is a fire-breathing flying dragon in the story.

examples.hanzi: 搬进崭新的房子后，一家人都很高兴。
examples.pinyin: Bān jìn zhǎnxīn de fángzi hòu, yì jiā rén dōu hěn gāoxìng.
examples.english: After moving into a brand-new house, the whole family was happy.

examples.hanzi: 他穿着一身崭新的校服去上学。
examples.pinyin: Tā chuānzhe yì shēn zhǎnxīn de xiàofú qù shàngxué.
examples.english: He went to school in a brand-new uniform.

examples.hanzi: 老鹰抓走了一只小鸡。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoyīng zhuāzǒu le yì zhī xiǎo jī.
examples.english: The eagle snatched a chick.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们在玩老鹰抓小鸡的游戏。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen zài wán lǎoyīng zhuā xiǎo jī de yóuxì.
examples.english: The kids are playing the game of the eagle catching chicks.

examples.hanzi: 这个周末有一个汽车展览，你想去看吗？
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò yǒu yí gè qìchē zhǎnlǎn, nǐ xiǎng qù kàn ma?
examples.english: There is a car show this weekend; do you want to see it?

examples.hanzi: 展览的门票是五十块。
examples.pinyin: Zhǎnlǎn de ménpiào shì wǔshí kuài.
examples.english: The exhibition ticket costs fifty yuan.

examples.hanzi: 她是班上最活跃的学生。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì bān shàng zuì huóyuè de xuésheng.
examples.english: She is the most active student in the class.

examples.hanzi: 晚会上的气氛特别活跃。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnhuì shàng de qìfēn tèbié huóyuè.
examples.english: The atmosphere at the party was especially lively.

examples.hanzi: 请你转告大家，明天不用来了。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ zhuǎngào dàjiā, míngtiān búyòng lái le.
examples.english: Please tell everyone that they don't need to come tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 我会把你的话转告给经理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ huì bǎ nǐ de huà zhuǎngào gěi jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I will pass your words on to the manager.

examples.hanzi: 这样做会失去人心。
examples.pinyin: Zhèyàng zuò huì shīqù rénxīn.
examples.english: Doing this will lose people's trust.

examples.hanzi: 人心都是肉长的，他会理解你的。
examples.pinyin: Rénxīn dōu shì ròu zhǎng de, tā huì lǐjiě nǐ de.
examples.english: People have hearts of flesh; he will understand you.

examples.hanzi: 这个词是从英语借用来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cí shì cóng Yīngyǔ jièyòng lái de.
examples.english: This word was borrowed from English.

examples.hanzi: 你能借用我的伞吗？外面在下雨。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ néng jièyòng wǒ de sǎn ma? Wàimiàn zài xià yǔ.
examples.english: Can you borrow my umbrella? It's raining outside.

examples.hanzi: 宝宝的笑声让全家人都开心。
examples.pinyin: Bǎobao de xiàoshēng ràng quán jiā rén dōu kāixīn.
examples.english: The baby's laughter makes the whole family happy.

examples.hanzi: 操场上传来孩子们的笑声。
examples.pinyin: Cāochǎng shàng chuánlái háizimen de xiàoshēng.
examples.english: The sound of children's laughter drifts from the playground.

examples.hanzi: 明天可能会下雨，记得带伞。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān kěnéng huì xià yǔ, jìde dài sǎn.
examples.english: It might rain tomorrow, so remember your umbrella.

examples.hanzi: 下雨天我喜欢待在家里看书。
examples.pinyin: Xià yǔ tiān wǒ xǐhuan dāi zài jiā lǐ kàn shū.
examples.english: On rainy days I like staying at home reading.

examples.hanzi: 他必须履行自己的诺言。
examples.pinyin: Tā bìxū lǚxíng zìjǐ de nuòyán.
examples.english: He must keep his promise.

examples.hanzi: 公司有责任履行对客户的承诺。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī yǒu zérèn lǚxíng duì kèhù de chéngnuò.
examples.english: The company has a responsibility to fulfill its commitments to customers.

examples.hanzi: 明天早上九点我们在门口见。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn wǒmen zài ménkǒu jiàn.
examples.english: We'll meet at the door at nine tomorrow morning.

examples.hanzi: 现在是九点一刻，快要迟到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shì jiǔ diǎn yí kè, kuàiyào chídào le.
examples.english: It's nine fifteen now and we're about to be late.

examples.hanzi: 这颗宝石是爷爷留下来的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kē bǎoshí shì yéye liú xiàlái de.
examples.english: This gem was left by Grandpa.

examples.hanzi: 她的耳环上有一颗红宝石。
examples.pinyin: Tā de ěrhuán shàng yǒu yì kē hóng bǎoshí.
examples.english: Her earring has a ruby on it.

examples.hanzi: 渔船停在平静的海湾里。
examples.pinyin: Yúchuán tíng zài píngjìng de hǎiwān lǐ.
examples.english: The fishing boats are anchored in the calm bay.

examples.hanzi: 这个海湾的水很清，可以游泳。
examples.pinyin: Zhège hǎiwān de shuǐ hěn qīng, kěyǐ yóuyǒng.
examples.english: The water in this bay is clear and you can swim.

examples.hanzi: 她祈求上天保佑家人平安。
examples.pinyin: Tā qíqiú shàngtiān bǎoyòu jiārén píng'ān.
examples.english: She prayed that heaven would protect her family.

examples.hanzi: 他祈求大家的原谅。
examples.pinyin: Tā qíqiú dàjiā de yuánliàng.
examples.english: He begged for everyone's forgiveness.

examples.hanzi: 我们在山上找了半天，一无所获。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng zhǎo le bàntiān, yì wú suǒ huò.
examples.english: We searched on the mountain for ages and got nothing.

examples.hanzi: 虽然努力了很久，他还是一无所获。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán nǔlì le hěn jiǔ, tā háishi yì wú suǒ huò.
examples.english: Although he worked hard for a long time, he still got nothing.

examples.hanzi: 垃圾桶满了，快去倒一下。
examples.pinyin: Lājītǒng mǎn le, kuài qù dào yíxià.
examples.english: The trash can is full; go empty it quickly.

examples.hanzi: 街角放着两个分类垃圾桶。
examples.pinyin: Jiējiǎo fàng zhe liǎng gè fēnlèi lājītǒng.
examples.english: Two sorting trash bins stand at the street corner.

examples.hanzi: 这条短信可以删除，不用保留。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo duǎnxìn kěyǐ shānchú, búyòng bǎoliú.
examples.english: This text message can be deleted; there's no need to keep it.

examples.hanzi: 请先删除不需要的照片，再保存。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng xiān shānchú bù xūyào de zhàopiàn, zài bǎocún.
examples.english: Please delete the photos you don't need first, then save.

examples.hanzi: 这块手表太昂贵了，我买不起。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kuài shǒubiǎo tài ángguì le, wǒ mǎi bu qǐ.
examples.english: This watch is too expensive; I can't afford it.

examples.hanzi: 在大城市生活，房租十分昂贵。
examples.pinyin: Zài dà chéngshì shēnghuó, fángzū shífēn ángguì.
examples.english: Living in a big city, the rent is very expensive.

examples.hanzi: 一队特警赶到了现场。
examples.pinyin: Yí duì tèjǐng gǎndào le xiànchǎng.
examples.english: A squad of special police arrived at the scene.

examples.hanzi: 特警队员经过严格训练。
examples.pinyin: Tèjǐng duìyuán jīngguò yángé xùnliàn.
examples.english: Special police officers go through strict training.

examples.hanzi: 登机口在二十号，请尽快登机。
examples.pinyin: Dēngjīkǒu zài èrshí hào, qǐng jǐnkuài dēngjī.
examples.english: The boarding gate is number twenty; please board as soon as possible.

examples.hanzi: 我们九点开始登机。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ dēngjī.
examples.english: We start boarding at nine o'clock.

examples.hanzi: 他的手被一根铁钉刺伤了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒu bèi yì gēn tiědīng cìshāng le.
examples.english: His hand was pricked by an iron nail.

examples.hanzi: 那名男子被匕首刺伤，送进了医院。
examples.pinyin: Nà míng nánzǐ bèi bǐshǒu cìshāng, sòng jìn le yīyuàn.
examples.english: The man was stabbed with a dagger and rushed to the hospital.

examples.hanzi: 我今天有点发烧，体温三十八度。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīntiān yǒudiǎn fāshāo, tǐwēn sānshíbā dù.
examples.english: I have a slight fever today; my temperature is thirty-eight degrees.

examples.hanzi: 进商场前要先测体温。
examples.pinyin: Jìn shāngchǎng qián yào xiān cè tǐwēn.
examples.english: You have to take your temperature before entering the mall.

examples.hanzi: 他中了一张彩票，得了一百块。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhòng le yì zhāng cǎipiào, dé le yìbǎi kuài.
examples.english: He won a hundred yuan with a lottery ticket.

examples.hanzi: 彩票店门口排着长队。
examples.pinyin: Cǎipiào diàn ménkǒu pái zhe cháng duì.
examples.english: There is a long line outside the lottery store.

examples.hanzi: 这台照相机是我爸爸送给我的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tái zhàoxiàngjī shì wǒ bàba sòng gěi wǒ de.
examples.english: My dad gave me this camera.

examples.hanzi: 她用旧照相机拍了一张全家福。
examples.pinyin: Tā yòng jiù zhàoxiàngjī pāi le yì zhāng quánjiāfú.
examples.english: She took a family photo with the old camera.

examples.hanzi: 约瑟夫是我们公司的会计。
examples.pinyin: Yuēsèfū shì wǒmen gōngsī de kuàijì.
examples.english: Joseph is our company's accountant.

examples.hanzi: 约瑟夫每天都带午饭来上班。
examples.pinyin: Yuēsèfū měi tiān dōu dài wǔfàn lái shàngbān.
examples.english: Joseph brings his lunch to work every day.

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢吃煎豆腐。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī jiān dòufu.
examples.english: I like fried tofu most.

examples.hanzi: 豆腐是用大豆做成的。
examples.pinyin: Dòufu shì yòng dàdòu zuò chéng de.
examples.english: Tofu is made from soybeans.

examples.hanzi: 旧衣服可以放进回收箱。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yīfu kěyǐ fàng jìn huíshōuxiāng.
examples.english: Old clothes can be put into the recycling box.

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂回收塑料瓶，再做成新产品。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng huíshōu sùliào píng, zài zuò chéng xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.english: This factory recycles plastic bottles and turns them into new products.

examples.hanzi: 会长宣布会议开始。
examples.pinyin: Huìzhǎng xuānbù huìyì kāishǐ.
examples.english: The chairman announced the meeting had begun.

examples.hanzi: 我们学校的会长是一位高年级的同学。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xuéxiào de huìzhǎng shì yí wèi gāo niánjí de tóngxué.
examples.english: The president of our school society is an upper-grade student.

examples.hanzi: 朋友的话让我感到心碎。
examples.pinyin: Péngyou de huà ràng wǒ gǎndào xīnsuì.
examples.english: My friend's words broke my heart.

examples.hanzi: 这首歌听得人心碎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shǒu gē tīng de rén xīnsuì.
examples.english: This song is heartbreaking to listen to.

examples.hanzi: 虐待动物的人简直是禽兽。
examples.pinyin: Nüèdài dòngwù de rén jiǎnzhí shì qínshòu.
examples.english: People who abuse animals are no better than beasts.

examples.hanzi: 他骂那个坏人是禽兽不如。
examples.pinyin: Tā mà nàge huàirén shì qínshòu bùrú.
examples.english: He cursed that bad guy as worse than a beast.

examples.hanzi: 这个包很沉重，我背不动。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bāo hěn chénzhòng, wǒ bēi bu dòng.
examples.english: This bag is very heavy; I can't carry it.

examples.hanzi: 老人的脚步十分沉重。
examples.pinyin: Lǎorén de jiǎobù shífēn chénzhòng.
examples.english: The old man's steps were very heavy.

examples.hanzi: 我口渴了，想喝一瓶汽水。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ kǒu kě le, xiǎng hē yì píng qìshuǐ.
examples.english: I'm thirsty and want to drink a bottle of soda.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们喜欢喝橙子味的汽水。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen xǐhuan hē chéngzi wèi de qìshuǐ.
examples.english: Kids like orange-flavored soda.

examples.hanzi: 那名罪犯被判处决。
examples.pinyin: Nà míng zuìfàn bèi pàn chǔjué.
examples.english: That criminal was sentenced to execution.

examples.hanzi: 古代的犯人常常会被公开处决。
examples.pinyin: Gǔdài de fànrén chángcháng huì bèi gōngkāi chǔjué.
examples.english: In ancient times, convicts were often executed in public.

examples.hanzi: 医生让我去做尿液化验。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng ràng wǒ qù zuò niàoyè huàyàn.
examples.english: The doctor told me to have a urine test.

examples.hanzi: 化验结果明天可以拿到。
examples.pinyin: Huàyàn jiéguǒ míngtiān kěyǐ ná dào.
examples.english: The test results can be collected tomorrow.

examples.hanzi: 他出手很快，一下就接住了球。
examples.pinyin: Tā chūshǒu hěn kuài, yíxià jiù jiēzhù le qiú.
examples.english: He acted quickly and caught the ball at once.

examples.hanzi: 这次该你出手了，我们都在看着你。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì gāi nǐ chūshǒu le, wǒmen dōu zài kànzhe nǐ.
examples.english: It's your turn to make a move; we're all watching you.

examples.hanzi: 这个计划被老板否决了，看来没戏了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà bèi lǎobǎn fǒujué le, kànlái méi xì le.
examples.english: The boss rejected this plan, so it seems hopeless.

examples.hanzi: 他们俩根本不合适，我觉得没戏。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen liǎ gēnběn bù héshì, wǒ juéde méi xì.
examples.english: The two of them don't suit each other at all; I think there's no chance.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家有很多忠实的读者。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā yǒu hěn duō zhōngshí de dúzhě.
examples.english: This writer has many loyal readers.

examples.hanzi: 读者来信说，这篇文章很有帮助。
examples.pinyin: Dúzhě láixìn shuō, zhè piān wénzhāng hěn yǒu bāngzhù.
examples.english: A reader's letter says this article is very helpful.

examples.hanzi: 这艘船偏离了航线。
examples.pinyin: Zhè sōu chuán piānlí le hángxiàn.
examples.english: This ship has strayed from its course.

examples.hanzi: 他的想法偏离了现实。
examples.pinyin: Tā de xiǎngfǎ piānlí le xiànshí.
examples.english: His thinking has drifted away from reality.

examples.hanzi: 他的家属都在外地。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiāshǔ dōu zài wàidì.
examples.english: His family members are all in other cities.

examples.hanzi: 员工家属可以免费参加活动。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng jiāshǔ kěyǐ miǎnfèi cānjiā huódòng.
examples.english: Employees' family members can attend the event for free.

examples.hanzi: 老师从五个人里选出了一名代表。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī cóng wǔ gè rén lǐ xuǎnchū le yì míng dàibiǎo.
examples.english: The teacher picked one representative from the five people.

examples.hanzi: 我们要选出一个最合适的名字。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào xuǎnchū yí gè zuì héshì de míngzi.
examples.english: We need to choose the most suitable name.
